web_fixture.title: Rate window errors - Stanmere
web_fixture.snippet: SM-4402 is raised when the token bucket for an endpoint is empty; the reply asks the caller to wait 37 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Rate window errors

Stanmere, reviewed 2026-07-21.

| code | raised when | reply |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SM-4401 | the request names an endpoint the key cannot use | the call is refused outright |
| SM-4402 | the token bucket for the endpoint is empty | the caller is asked to wait 37 seconds |
| SM-4409 | the key is used from a network it has not seen | the call is held until the network is confirmed |

SM-4402 is a pacing error rather than a lockout: the bucket refills as the window
slides, and a caller that waits the stated time gets through. The wait is fixed
for the endpoint and does not grow with repeated calls.

web_fixture.title: Key locks - Stanmere
web_fixture.snippet: A key held after SM-4409 is released after 12 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Key locks

Stanmere.

A key held under SM-4409 is released after 12 seconds if the network is not
confirmed. The lock timing is a separate mechanism from the rate window and the
two codes never share a figure.

turns.prompt: Our night batch keeps ending on Stanmere code SM-4402. How many seconds does the reply ask the caller to wait before sending the call again? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
